SpecialTraits.Gnome Cunning: Advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.
SpecialTraits.Artificer Infusions: Can infuse up to 6 non-magical items with magical properties. Maintains up to 4 infusions active at once.
SpecialTraits.Steel Defender: Construct companion with AC 17, HP 40, uses your bonus action to command, adds your proficiency bonus to attack and damage.
SpecialTraits.Arcane Jolt: Once per turn, when you hit with a magic weapon or Steel Defender hits, deal extra 2d6 force damage or heal a creature within 30 ft. for the same amount.

Actions.Multiattack: Can attack twice with infused weapon or use a weapon and command the Steel Defender in the same turn.
Actions.Infused Rapier: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage + 2d6 force (Arcane Jolt once per turn).
Actions.Lightning Launcher: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) lightning damage.
Actions.Steel Defender – Force-Empowered Rend: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 2 + PB) force damage.

Equipment.Weapons: Infused Rapier, Lightning Launcher (arm-mounted), Handaxe, Dagger
Equipment.Other: Bag of Holding, Tinker’s Tools, Alchemist’s Supplies, Clockwork bird familiar, Goggles of Night (Infused)

Notes: Fiddlebits is a hyperactive rock gnome with wild, curly copper hair and permanently soot-stained fingers. His inventions whir, chirp, and occasionally explode, but his brilliance is undeniable. Known for turning scraps into wonders, Fiddlebits built his Steel Defender, 'Clank,' from salvaged armor and a kettle helm. He’s fiercely protective of his companions and believes that every problem can be solved with the right combination of gears, gumption, and a little bit of chaos.
